nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

description: Amazon Research JS: product database/query API.

categories.description: Main category names, separated by commas, must match the standard category names of the corresponding site. Examples of US sites: Appliances, Arts Crafts & Sewing, Automotive, Baby, Beauty & Personal Care, Books, CDs & Vinyl, Cell Phones & Accessories, Clothing Shoes & Jewelry, Collectibles & Fine Art, Computers, Digital Music, Electronics, Garden & Outdoor, Grocery & Gourmet Food, Handmade, Health Household & Baby Care, Home & Kitchen, Industrial & Scientific, Kindle Store, Kitchen & Dining, Movies & TV, Musical Instruments, Office Products, Pet Supplies, Sports & Outdoors, Tools & Home Improvement, Toys & Games, Video Games, etc.; other sites have corresponding local category names

excludeKeywords.description: Title/ASIN excluded keywords, comma separated, up to 100 items, each item can be up to 50 characters

includeKeywords.description: Title/ASIN contains keywords, comma separated, up to 100 items, each item can be up to 50 characters

needCount.description: The total number of results to be returned, automatic paging within the API

productTiers.description: Product size hierarchy, separated by commas. Optional values: `oversize`, `standard`

sellerTypes.description: Seller types, separated by commas. Optional values: `amz` (Amazon self-operated), `fba`, `fbm`

sort.description: Sort field. Allowed values: `name`, `-name`, `category`, `-category`, `revenue`, `-revenue`, `sales`, `-sales`, `price`, `-price`, `rank`, `-rank`, `reviews`, `-reviews`, `lqs`, `-lqs`, `sellers`, `-sellers`, `-`. A leading `-` sorts in descending order.

name: nexscope_data_js_product_database_query
